eng_translation: Pyelonephritis is a medical condition that involves inflammation of the kidney and the renal pelvis, typically caused by a bacterial infection. It is often a complication of a urinary tract infection (UTI) that has spread from the bladder to the kidneys. Symptoms may include fever, flank pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. Diagnosis is usually confirmed through urine analysis and culture, and treatment typically involves antibiotics. In severe cases, hospitalization may be required.

eng_translation: Ertapenem is a carbapenem antibiotic used to treat a variety of bacterial infections. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall, leading to the death of the bacteria. Ertapenem is effective against a broad spectrum of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, including both aerobic and anaerobic organisms. It is typically administered intravenously and is often used in the treatment of complicated intra-abdominal infections, community-acquired pneumonia, and skin and skin structure infections. Ertapenem is generally well-tolerated, but like all antibiotics, it can cause side effects such as gastrointestinal disturbances, allergic reactions, and, in rare cases, more serious adverse effects. It is important to use ertapenem only as prescribed by a healthcare provider to help prevent the development of antibiotic resistance.
